items.q: How long is the full stack course?
items.a: It runs for 20 weeks, in milestones of four weeks each, from fundamentals to deploying live projects.
The MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js), TypeScript, API integration and cloud deployment, along with AI models such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and Groq.

items.q: How much does the full stack course cost?
items.a: Share your details on the enquiry form or WhatsApp +91 84619 58162. Our team replies with the fee, payment options and the next batch date.

items.q: Can I join if I am a fresher or from a non-IT background?
items.a: Yes. The course begins with the fundamentals and builds up step by step.

items.q: Will I have a portfolio when I finish?
items.a: Yes. You host your best projects online and finish with a portfolio website to show recruiters.

items.q: Is there any hands-on practice besides the lessons?
items.a: Yes. The course includes hackathons and build jams where you ship code alongside mentors.

items.q: What roles can I apply for after the course?
items.a: Full Stack Developer, Front-End Developer, Back-End Developer and AI-assisted web developer roles.
Yes. We provide placement support and share your profile with our hiring partners. Hiring decisions stay with the employer.
